newsitem.title: USA: RightChoice parent wins court ruling.
newsitem.headline: RightChoice parent wins court ruling.

text.p: Blue Cross and Blue Shield of Missouri said Monday a Missouri court ruled it followed all applicable laws and regulations in its 1994 reorganization and public offering of 20 percent of its RightChoice Managed Care Inc unit.

Cole County, Missouri, Circuit Judge Thomas Brown, also enjoined the Missouri Department of Insurance from taking any administrative action against the company related to the reorganization, the company said.
The judge said and the Department of Insurance has no authority to force any payment in connection with the reorganization and public offering, the company said.

The judge also ruled that the insurance deparment lacks jurisdiction to modify or reverse the administrative approval of the reorganization and public offering; and that Blue Cross and Blue Shield of Missouri has no legal obligation to make any payment to the State of Missouri or any other entity as a result of the reorganization and public offering, the company said.

On October 25, the court is scheduled to hear arguments on the remaining counterclaim filed on June 20 by the Missouri Attorney General and joined by the Director and Department of Insurance. The counterclaim alleges that the reorganization and public offering, and the continued operations through RightChoice and its subsidiaries, exceed Blue Cross and Blue Shield of Missouri's statutory purposes, the company said.
